issue: Prior business model excludes paid random equipment
proposal: Redefine product value, not just a new home button

issue: Natural top quality already has a steady source
proposal: Test desirable types/affixes/appearance rather than silently cutting free drops

issue: Larger equipment catalog dilutes an individual's desired item
proposal: Targeted selection and explicit target guarantee, versioned pools

issue: Paid pulls can bypass first-boss and first-craft gates
proposal: Apply existing eligibility and available-recipient rules to offer before charging

issue: Purchased top rank may refund investment never actually paid
proposal: Track actual investment and acquisition lineage separately from current rank

issue: Natural pity, paid-quality pity and target pity can be conflated
proposal: Separate counters, sequential batch processing, idempotent result replay

issue: Permanent benefits accumulate without a lifetime ceiling
proposal: One bounded additive living-effect group shared with free research

issue: HP and support thresholds may react non-monotonically to permanent bonuses
proposal: Re-run R6 paired seeds for actual bonus candidates after original runner is available

issue: Armor stats and purchased look can overwrite each other
proposal: Equipment instance, owned outfit and selected appearance are separate state

issue: 24 key poses do not provide complete costume animations
proposal: One end-to-end additional outfit and weapon-attachment prototype before scaling

issue: Furniture replacements reveal unpainted areas or break sitting/occlusion
proposal: Empty-room underpaint, compatible sockets and interaction anchors

issue: 159 region units do not include new hero outfits, house or weapon presentation kits
proposal: Keep region ledger; add separate scoped workstreams with counts not yet frozen

issue: Local paid-draw state can be replayed/lost/conflict across devices
proposal: Verified account, authoritative draw ledger and versioned offline journal

issue: App Store purchase restoration does not restore spent-draw contents
proposal: Persist original draw outcomes and item lineage; distinguish app rights from game save

issue: Refund after currency/item evolution needs a non-destructive policy
proposal: Define lineage-aware correction and customer explanation before sales

issue: Specific paid item combinations and premium currency obligations
proposal: Check actual acquisition/recipe paths, odds disclosures, age rating, prepaid status

issue: Previewed rights, owned content, downloaded assets and equipped appearance differ
proposal: Do not treat preview/download as ownership; explicit download/restore/pending states

issue: The same party appears at home while expedition progress continues
proposal: Home as return/rest vignette of repeated patrols, not literal simultaneous location

issue: Finite chapters and item ceilings may not sustain recurring equipment sales
proposal: Validate actual desired products, content cadence, contribution after costs
